description: Backend result-shape change so the catalog lookup exposes ALL top-K matches. image_lookup gains an additive `matches` list (each {s3_uri, name, distance}) while keeping its existing top-level keys; ToolResultCollector gains latest_image_lookup_matches() while keeping latest_ok_s3_uri(). Self-contained with its own unit tests; independent of the UI feature except that FEAT-002 depends on these accessors, so this comes first.
steps: In components/agent/tools/image_lookup.py image_lookup_impl: after `hits = response.get("vectors") or []` and the zero-hit not_found guard, build `matches = [{"s3_uri": m.get("s3_uri"), "name": m.get("name"), "distance": h.get("distance")} for h in hits for m in [h.get("metadata") or {}] if m.get("s3_uri")]`. If `matches` is empty (no hit had an s3_uri), keep the existing not_found path (use hits[0].get('distance') for the message as today). Otherwise return `ok(s3_uri=matches[0]["s3_uri"], distance=matches[0]["distance"], matches=matches, message="match found")`. Do not change the two existing not_found branches' semantics; `ok(**fields)` already passes `matches` through into the json payload.
Update the image_lookup @tool docstring Returns block to document the new `matches` list key alongside the existing s3_uri/distance keys.

In components/agent/hooks.py add method `latest_image_lookup_matches(self) -> list[dict]` to ToolResultCollector: iterate `reversed(self.results)`; for each `(name, result)` where `name == "image_lookup"`, extract `payload = result["content"][0]["json"]` guarded by try/except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError) exactly like latest_ok_s3_uri(); if `payload.get("result") == "ok"`, return `payload.get("matches", [])`. Return `[]` if none match. Leave latest_ok_s3_uri() unchanged.

In tests/test_image_lookup.py add test_lookup_returns_all_topk_matches: feed RecordingS3Vectors three hits — two with metadata {s3_uri, name} and distinct distances, one WITHOUT an s3_uri — assert payload["result"]=="ok", len(payload["matches"])==2, matches preserve hit order, each has keys s3_uri/name/distance, and payload["s3_uri"]/payload["distance"] equal matches[0]. Keep existing image_lookup tests unchanged (they must still pass).

In tests/test_envelope.py add test_collector_returns_latest_image_lookup_matches: record an image_lookup ok result built via ok(s3_uri=..., matches=[{...},{...}]) and assert latest_image_lookup_matches() returns that list; add test_collector_matches_empty_when_not_found (latest image_lookup is not_found -> []) and test that returns [] when no image_lookup ran. Reuse the existing FakeAfterToolCallEvent helper.
acceptance_criteria: image_lookup_impl success envelope contains a `matches` list where every element has keys s3_uri (str), name (str|None), distance (float|None), covering ALL top-K hits that carried an s3_uri in metadata.
payload["s3_uri"] and payload["distance"] still equal matches[0] (backward-compat with latest_ok_s3_uri() and existing tests).
ToolResultCollector.latest_image_lookup_matches() returns the newest ok image_lookup matches list, or [] when there is none; latest_ok_s3_uri() behavior is unchanged.
`python3 -m pytest -q` passes the full suite (baseline 35 + the new tests) with no modifications to existing assertions.
findings: For FEAT-002: On an 'ok' image_lookup envelope the json payload now carries payload['matches'] (key: 'matches'), a list[dict]. Each element has exactly three keys: 's3_uri' (str, always present/non-null for list members), 'name' (str|None, from vector metadata), 'distance' (float|None). Matches preserve S3 Vectors hit order (best/nearest first) and include ALL top-K hits whose metadata carried an s3_uri; hits without an s3_uri are dropped. Top-level payload['s3_uri'] and payload['distance'] still mirror matches[0] (backward-compat). The 'matches' key is ABSENT on not_found/error envelopes. Accessor: ToolResultCollector.latest_image_lookup_matches() -> list[dict]; returns the newest ok image_lookup matches list, or [] when the latest image_lookup was not_found/error, when no matches key exists, or when no image_lookup ran. latest_ok_s3_uri() is unchanged. Full suite: 39 passed (35 baseline + 4 new).
